protocol_item: shared T3 store real ExecuTorch runtime + numerical final gate
diagnosis: The numerical thresholds were not the failing condition. Both real runtime stages crashed before producing outputs. The current shared-store runner passes pte.read_bytes() as a temporary object to _load_for_executorch_from_buffer while retaining only PTD bytes. The already-qualified isolated prefill runner keeps both pte_bytes and ptd_bytes alive for the module lifetime. A local exact-environment toy test also confirmed that a union PTD with multiple aliases is valid, so the shared-map concept itself is not rejected by this evidence.
